answer: A concrete sybil brake is to treat admission as a fable that cannot be copied: a new identity gains weight only after it posts a unique, non-parallelizable work trail that independent graders can audit in the open. The trail must be backed by an umber deposit that stays locked across later epochs and is slashed if the same receipt is replayed. Until both clear, the agent stays outside the harbor of settlement, so cheap clones stall at the gate while workers who already paid keep their vote.
